android.desc:
Unfluke is your all-in-one stock market companion built for Indian traders and investors. Whether you're analyzing NSE stocks, scanning for breakouts, backtesting strategies, or exploring option chains, Unfluke brings everything into one powerful, easy-to-use app.

AI-POWERED CHATBOT
Ask anything about Indian stocks in plain English. Get instant answers about company fundamentals, financial ratios, market trends, and trading strategies. Our AI is trained on Indian market data and understands queries like "What is the P/E ratio of Reliance?" or "Compare HDFC Bank vs ICICI Bank revenue growth."

REAL-TIME STOCK SCANNERS
Discover trading opportunities as they happen. Scan NSE-listed stocks for breakouts, volume surges, momentum plays, 52-week highs and lows, and technical setups. Use pre-built scanners or create your own with custom indicators like RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, and moving averages.

FUNDAMENTAL SCREENER
Deep-dive into company financials with 100+ metrics: P/E ratio, ROE, debt-to-equity, EPS growth, dividend yield, market cap, revenue growth, profit margins, and more. Compare stocks side-by-side and filter by your criteria to find quality companies in seconds.

BACKTESTING ENGINE
Test your trading ideas on historical data before risking real money. Both basic and advanced backtesters available. Try simple moving average crossovers, RSI-based strategies, or build complex multi-leg setups. View detailed performance reports including win rate, drawdown, profit factor, and equity curves.

OPTION SIMULATOR
Master option strategies with visual payoff charts. Choose from 40+ pre-built strategies including Long Call, Bull Call Spread, Iron Condor, Butterfly, Straddle, Strangle, Calendar Spreads, and more. See profit and loss zones, breakeven points, and Greeks before placing real trades.

ADVANCED SCANNERS AND ALERTS
Build custom scanners with multiple conditions combining technical and fundamental filters. Get notifications when stocks match your criteria.

STRATEGY CHARTS
Visualize multi-leg option strategies in interactive charts. Understand where you make money, where you lose, and how each leg contributes to overall P&L.

WHY TRADERS LOVE UNFLUKE:
Clean, intuitive interface designed for mobile-first trading.
Lightning-fast scanners that update in real-time.
AI chatbot that understands Indian markets, not generic global data.
Comprehensive fundamentals, no need to switch between multiple apps.
Free to use core features.
